Hi Aditi / Tom —

Thanks — received the questionnaire. I reviewed the key asks and here are concise answers plus an attachment with the ID/access evidence template we use for customers. See inline below for quick responses to your bullets: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security + availability) — most recent report period ended 2027-05-31. We can provide the auditor letter under NDA; if you need the full report, we have a process to share via secure link.
- HIPAA / BAA: We have a standard BAA template; happy to run that through legal with a marked copy for your team.
- SAML: we will provide SP metadata (entityID, ACS URL, cert) and a short integration guide.
- SCIM: our SCIM 2.0 endpoint supports bulk provisioning, PATCH updates for phone/title, and group sync. We'll include endpoints, auth (Bearer token), throttling limits, and example payloads.
- RBAC / admin roles: attached is our admin role matrix mapping permissions to UI/console/API capabilities.
- Audit & retention: system audit logs retained for 365 days by default; longer retention available as an add-on.

Attachments included: redwood-iam-evidence-template.md (map of artifacts we can deliver), and an export sample of our admin-role-matrix.csv. I'll follow up with the SAML metadata and SCIM spec via secure link within 48 hours.

Proposed timeline:
- EOD Thu 2027-08-12: initial evidence bundle (template + role matrix + SOC attestation notice) — OK for us to meet Tom's procurement date?
- By Tue 2027-08-17: SAML metadata + SCIM endpoint docs + sample provisioning run (if you want a sandbox).

If that works, Rishi and Monica will be your day-to-day contacts for technical onboarding and procurement coordination.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
